Brakes last done in 2025.
Most recent inspection Aug 2026.
Car is in great running condition. Suspension inspected and no issues found so should get a good number of years on it. Has roof rack and hitch.
It’s a toyota, engine is in great shape oil changes done every 5k miles. 
There has been some cosmetic damage, a small dent in the trunk and some broken clips on the front right bumper. I can’t speak to any issues on the other bumpers or trim but it’s getting older and unfortunately those plastic clips are known to wear.
No issues with cooling or heating, no issues with interior cosmetic damage.
I have videos of the inside and outside and of it driving.

Enhanced Security system from when I worked in Allentown.

Remote start from any distance. Able to be shared through app access. 
Live tracking through app… be warned your gf will track you on that if you share app access.
2.5 sets of keys, two for ignition two for remote start.

For sale is a used 2017 Honda CR-V EX-L with AWD. Asking $15,700 or best offer. For sale is a used 2017 Honda CR-V EX-L. 
Please see the link to the autotrader ad: https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/vehicle/791590077?LNX=psxlinkshare
I'm the original owner of the car. It has ~108,000 miles and is in good condition with no known problems. Always well taken care of with regular oil changes and other scheduled maintenance items. 
It is an EX-L so it has leather seats. It is also pretty well equipped with apple carplay, heated seats, two driver seat memory function, premium audio, etc.
I've never had any major issues with this car. Only a few very minor things here and there that were all easily taken care of. 
There is a stain on the back seat, which you can see in the pictures. Not sure what caused this stain, but we were never able to get it removed. It might have been come from one of our kid's toys, but not really sure. The exterior has some scratches & nicks here and there, but nothing that wouldn't be expected from a car of its age.
The only reason I'm selling it is because I am planning to buy a pick-up truck. 
Please reach out with any questions.
Thank you!

description:
Approx. 177K Miles, inspected until next fall.
Selling my Altima due to recently upgrading to a more practical family car. I am the 2nd owner of the car and acquired the vehicle from my father-in-law in 2017. It has been super reliable over the years and is currently in good mechanical condition with zero lights on in the dash. It does have blemishes as expected with a 16-year-old car. Most notably is the passenger side door damage where my wife backed into it in the driveway. Below is a list of recently replaced items, known issues, and modifications to the car.
Modifications:
1. Windows tinted
2. Lowered on H&R lowering springs
3. Wheel spacers all around
4. Drilled and slotted brakes all around
5. K&N panel air filter 
Pros:
1. The following have been replaced in the past year
a. Front control arms
b. Front wheel bearings
c. Front CV axles
d. Tires
e. Brakes
f. Motor Mounts
2. I have a spare set of rear rotors and pads to go with the car
Cons:
1. Passenger side door damage – purely cosmetic 
2. Left front fender has a scrap
3. Dents and dings – Kids are great!
4. Areas of clear coat degradation

title: 2010 Nissan Rogue – ~160,000 Miles – As-Is
description:
2010 Nissan Rogue – ~160,000 Miles – As-Is
Selling my 2010 Nissan Rogue with close to 160,000 miles. The radiator has been replaced after the original developed a crack.
Known issues / condition:
-Transmission/CVT: Has a P0744 code. The issue only manifests during prolonged periods of extreme heat (I moved from LA--where I did two drives SF-->LA 5 hours in 104 degree weather) combined with uphill driving in the grapevine, when the car can lose power. 
-Exterior: One dent on the rear of the vehicle.
-Interior: Some leather on the front seat is ripping (see photos for condition).
-Air conditioner doesn't work
-the gas light "empty" sensor will come on around when you have half, or quarter tank, and will only readjust if you're driving for a while. This hasn't been too much of a problem, since I remember what my gas is 
-the sensor lights tend to turn on when they want--seatbelt (even if it's clicked) and "service engine" even if you have serviced it (my mechanic told me it'll just keep doing that)
-The car has cosmetic wear consistent with its age and mileage. Selling as-is, with the known issues disclosed.
More about the car:
AWD
Title is clear, and hand but is from out of state. It's my mother's car but she's signed over the title. Buyer should confirm the title and registration requirements before purchase.
Please message me with any questions or to arrange a time to see the car.
